subject: Yuk-Yuk
fact: Yuk-Yuk is a curious goblin who was promised 20 gold and convinced by Jimjar to follow him into the dangerous tunnels.
source_quote: Their group expanded to include two members, the curious goblins Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait. They were promised 20 gold, and Jimjar convinced them to follow him into the dangerous tunnels.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait is a curious goblin who was promised 20 gold and convinced by Jimjar to follow him into the dangerous tunnels.
source_quote: Their group expanded to include two members, the curious goblins Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait. They were promised 20 gold, and Jimjar convinced them to follow him into the dangerous tunnels.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar convinced the curious goblins Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait to follow him into the dangerous tunnels and later made a bet with Grygum about Thorin's climb.
source_quote: Jimjar convinced them to follow him into the dangerous tunnels. "Wanna make a bet?" "That’s the spirit. He makes it, or doesn’t it?"

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin suddenly loses it, screaming, laughing, and weeping for ten minutes, then recovers and volunteers to climb the cavern roof to cross the gorge.
source_quote: But it is Thorin who suddenly loses it abruptly. He starts screaming, laughing, and weeping. After about ten minutes... he recovers. Thorin volunteers. He takes a rope, ties it around his waist, and then begins the hazardous sport of climbing to the roof of the cavern and then the gorge.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar the Awakened sees Thorin’s bout of madness and remarks that perhaps in Sloobludop, the archpriest Ploopploopeen can help.
source_quote: Shuushar the Awakened sees Thorin’s bout of madness and remarks that perhaps in Sloobludop, the archpriest Ploopploopeen can help. "Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother, and she will be most welcoming of my awakening to the end of our people’s madness."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters that Ploopploopeen is a tongue twister and later asks Jimjar to bet on whether monsters will be found in the tomb.
source_quote: Grygum mutters, "That’s quite a bit of tongue twister." ... Grygum, enjoying the taste of toasted Ripplebark, asks Jimjar, "Wanna bet that we’ll find monsters in the tomb?"

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is emphatic that leaving corpses will leave a trail, and Zalthir believes him due to the Derro’s conviction.
source_quote: Buppido is emphatic that this will leave a trail. For some reason, Zalthir believes Buppido. There is something about the Derro’s conviction.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir mutters that he cannot fly across the gorge but later realizes the ceiling allows climbing over it, and he decides to drop the bodies into the gorge based on Buppido’s advice.
source_quote: Zalthir mutters, "If only I could fly, I could get across. But I don’t, and there is no way to climb across it." ... Zalthir looks up and suddenly realizes he’s in a cave with a ceiling that allows anyone to climb over the gorge. ... And so the bodies are dropped into the bottomless gorge.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth smiles near a pool of water, finds waterorbs, and later identifies Tinmmasks as poisonous spore-emitting toadstools after examining a corpse.
source_quote: Near a pool of water, the Eldeth smiles. She has found waterorbs. ... "Stop," she shouts. She is standing in front of a cave covered with mushrooms. She shouts, "Tinmmasks." ... She looks at a corpse, "that’s what happened to that guy."

subject: Stool
fact: Stool shouts, "That’s a cool mushroom!" and names it Nilhogg's nose, explaining its sensory-enhancing but painful properties.
source_quote: As the group watches the bodies fall, Stool shouts, "That’s a cool mushroom!" He calls the mushroom a Nilhogg's nose. The young Myconid explains, "You can eat it, but it won’t fill you up. But after eating it, you can smell better and find good mushrooms and other smells. It’s like the smells become so much more. But if you smell a bad smell, it hurts you a lot more."

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir seems particularly affected by the Faerzress's magic and insists they should check out the lost temple and find the treasure.
source_quote: And Sethir seems particularly affected. ... Sethir insists they should check out the lost temple and find the treasure.

subject: Silken Tunnels
fact: The Silken Tunnels are behind the group as they enter the dark depths of the Underdark.
source_quote: The Silken Tunnels are behind them now, and the dark depths of the Underdark are ahead.

subject: Underdark
fact: The Underdark is ahead of the group and contains Ripplebark, waterorbs, Faerzress magic, and dangerous tunnels.
source_quote: The dark depths of the Underdark are ahead. ... They find some Ripplebark... ... the Faerzress's eerie magic.

subject: bottomless gorge
fact: The bottomless gorge is crossed by Thorin climbing the cavern ceiling, and the bodies of bandits are dropped into it.
source_quote: He finds himself in a massive cavern with what appears to be a bottomless gorge. ... And so the bodies are dropped into the bottomless gorge.

subject: cave covered with Tinmmasks
fact: A cave covered with squat toadstools called Tinmmasks is found, which emit poisonous spores when uprooted.
source_quote: She is standing in front of a cave covered with mushrooms. She shouts, "Tinmmasks." ... They are grouped in clusters, with no more than four in a cluster. ... it spews a cloud of spores out to a radius of 15 ft.

subject: Ripplebark
fact: Ripplebark is a rotten-fresh edible fungus found in the Underdark that can be roasted to improve its nutty flavor and neutralize disease germs.
source_quote: They find some Ripplebark that, despite its rotten fresh appearance, is entirely edible in its raw state and could be roasted to improve its nutty flavor. Scorched or burnt ripplebark turned black but was still edible. It could also neutralize disease germs.

subject: waterorbs
fact: Waterorbs are a fungus growing in shallow Underdark water that, when squeezed, yields about a gallon of potable water and leaves a bland, chewy husk.
source_quote: She has found waterorbs. As she explains, the Waterorb is a fungus that grows in the Underdark in shallow water. When mature, it was bulbous in shape and bigger than a human head. If squeezed and wrung out, it yields about a gallon (almost four liters) of potable water. The remaining husk was bland and chewy like a sponge but edible.

subject: Nilhogg's nose
fact: Nilhogg's nose is a mushroom that enhances smell but intensifies pain from bad odors and does not fill the eater.
source_quote: He calls the mushroom a Nilhogg's nose. The young Myconid explains, "You can eat it, but it won’t fill you up. But after eating it, you can smell better and find good mushrooms and other smells. It’s like the smells become so much more. But if you smell a bad smell, it hurts you a lot more."

subject: Tinmmasks
fact: Tinmmasks are squat toadstools with beige caps striped red and orange that emit a 15-ft radius cloud of spores causing confusion when uprooted.
source_quote: They are grouped in clusters, with no more than four in a cluster. The mushroom has a beige-colored cap crossed with red and orange stripes. ... if it is heavily damaged or killed by uprooting, it spews a cloud of spores out to a radius of 15 ft. All those within the cloud may be poisoned for about a minute and, when poisoned, are affected by the same effects of a confusion spell.

subject: water bladders
fact: Water bladders are vital adventuring gear found on the corpses of bandits after the ambush near the gorge.
source_quote: Zalthir is pleased to discover many vital pieces of adventuring gear on the corpses, the most important of which are water bladders.

subject: tinderbox
fact: Jimjar is excited about the tinderbox found on the bandit corpses, calling toasted Ripplebark the best thing in the Underdark.
source_quote: Jimjar, however, is excited about the tinderbox - "Toasted Ripplebark, the best thing in the Underdark."

subject: Drow of Velkynvelve
fact: The Drow of Velkynvelve is almost forgotten by the group as they journey deeper into the Underdark.
source_quote: The Drow of Velkynvelve is now almost forgotten.

subject: Derro
fact: The Derro are referenced through Buppido’s conviction, which leads Zalthir to trust his judgment about corpse disposal.
source_quote: For some reason, Zalthir believes Buppido. There is something about the Derro’s conviction.

subject: bandits
fact: Bandits dressed in a mix of armor and clothing, armed with scimitars and crossbows, attack Thorin after the gorge crossing and later ambush the group near the Tinmmasks cave.
source_quote: The attackers appear to be desperate bandits dressed in a mix of armor and clothing and armed with scimitars and crossbows. ... The friends show up. ... A group of bandits arrive under the flag of truce...

subject: undead
fact: Grygum and Jimjar bet on whether the lost tomb contains undead, with Jimjar dismissing skeletons and zombies as boring.
source_quote: Grygum asks Jimjar, "Wanna bet that we’ll find monsters in the tomb?" ... "Undead?" "Boring." "Skeletons and Zombies?" "I’ll take that bet."

subject: Thorin’s madness
fact: Thorin suddenly loses it, screaming, laughing, and weeping for ten minutes before recovering and claiming he is fine.
source_quote: But it is Thorin who suddenly loses it abruptly. He starts screaming, laughing, and weeping. After about ten minutes, during which no one is sure if he’s suffering from PTSD, whether the stress of the Underdark has become too much, or whether this is some religious ritual, he recovers. "I have no idea what happened. But I am fine now."

subject: climbing the cavern ceiling
fact: Thorin climbs the cavern ceiling to cross the gorge after Zalthir realizes the ceiling allows passage, tying a rope around his waist and dropping down on the other side.
source_quote: Zalthir looks up and suddenly realizes he’s in a cave with a ceiling that allows anyone to climb over the gorge. Thorin volunteers. He takes a rope, ties it around his waist, and then begins the hazardous sport of climbing to the roof of the cavern and then the gorge. He drops down as he gets to the other side of the gorge.

subject: bet on Thorin's climb
fact: Grygum bets with Jimjar that Thorin will make the climb, and Thorin overhears and shrugs before beginning his ascent.
source_quote: Grygum asks Jimjar - "Wanna make a bet?" Jimjar smiles, "That’s the spirit. He makes it, or doesn’t it?" "Makes it." Thorin overhears the bet and shrugs.

subject: corpses dropped into the gorge
fact: The group debates whether to leave or dispose of the bandit corpses and ultimately drops them into the bottomless gorge based on Buppido’s advice.
source_quote: Zalthir asks, "Do we leave the bodies here...?" That triggers a massive debate... And so the bodies are dropped into the bottomless gorge.

subject: Yuk Yuk’s murder
fact: Yuk Yuk is found dead with his throat cut by a shortsword, and Grygum notes any member of the group could have done it.
source_quote: There is the corpse of Yuk Yuk, his throat cut with a blade. Grygum examines the cut and notes, "It’s a shortsword. Any one of us could have done it."

subject: bandits offer false truce
fact: A group of bandits arrives under a flag of truce offering information about escaping the Underdark, but their story is a fabrication.
source_quote: A group of bandits arrive under the flag of truce, offering information about how to get out of the Underdark. ... Grygum, Eldeth, and Zalthir realize that the story is a fabrication and that the details are not that important.

subject: debate over escape route
fact: The group debates whether to go to Blingdenstone, Gracklstugh, or follow the Darklake, with Shuushar unwilling to go past Sloobludop.
source_quote: He shares with him that the best chance of escape is through the town of Blingdenstone. ... Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first... Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous... Shuushar says he has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop...

subject: bet on tomb monsters
fact: Grygum and Jimjar bet on whether the lost tomb contains undead, with Jimjar dismissing skeletons and zombies as boring and accepting the bet.
source_quote: Grygum asks Jimjar, "Wanna bet that we’ll find monsters in the tomb?" ... "Undead?" "Boring." "Skeletons and Zombies?" "I’ll take that bet."

subject: Eldeth’s rejection of Thorin’s giant connection
fact: Eldeth finds Thorin’s relationship with giants offputting due to the lingering effects of the War of the Giants after the War of the Dragons.
source_quote: In the evening, Thorin tries to talk to Eldeth. But the shield dwarf finds Thorin’s relationship with giants to be offputting. The War of the Giants that happened after the War of the Dragons ended in a peculiar stalemate. Although the Ordning was re-established, the giant civil war continued. And the effect on the people of the North was devastating.

subject: 9th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The events of the Silken Tunnels, the gorge crossing, Thorin’s madness, and the discovery of Ripplebark and waterorbs occur on this date.
source_quote: 9th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: 10th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: On this date, the group finds the Tinmmasks cave, discovers the escaped bandit’s corpse, and is ambushed by his friends.
source_quote: 10th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: On this date, Yuk Yuk is murdered with a shortsword, and the group awakens to his corpse.
source_quote: 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Ploopploopeen’s identity
fact: Shuushar claims Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother who welcomes awakenings to the end of their people’s madness, while Grygum thinks the name is a tongue twister.
source_quote: Shuushar the Awakened sees Thorin’s bout of madness and remarks that perhaps in Sloobludop, the archpriest Ploopploopeen can help. "Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother, and she will be most welcoming of my awakening to the end of our people’s madness." ... Grygum mutters, "That’s quite a bit of tongue twister."

subject: corpses as ecological disturbance
fact: A debate arises whether leaving corpses attracts trackers through ecosystem disturbance, with Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy believing monsters hinder pursuers, while Buppido insists it leaves a trail.
source_quote: Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy believe that the monsters will be a hindrance. Shuushar feels that the notion that trackers can discern anything from what the circle of life is is absurd. Buppido is emphatic that this will leave a trail.

subject: escape route strategy
fact: The group debates whether to go to Blingdenstone, Gracklstugh, or follow the Darklake, with conflicting opinions on safety and access.
source_quote: He shares with him that the best chance of escape is through the town of Blingdenstone. ... Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first... Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous... Shuushar says he has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop...

subject: Thorin’s relationship with giants
fact: Eldeth finds Thorin’s connection to giants offputting due to the unresolved civil war among giants after the War of the Dragons, despite the Ordning’s re-establishment.
source_quote: Eldeth finds Thorin’s relationship with giants to be offputting. The War of the Giants that happened after the War of the Dragons ended in a peculiar stalemate. Although the Ordning was re-established, the giant civil war continued. And the effect on the people of the North was devastating.

subject: tinderbox and toasted Ripplebark
fact: Jimjar declares toasted Ripplebark the best thing in the Underdark, linking the tinderbox to culinary preference and survival utility.
source_quote: Jimjar, however, is excited about the tinderbox - "Toasted Ripplebark, the best thing in the Underdark."
